Gray dots: pre-energy-gate tracker; blue: raw gated F0; green: retained original F0; pink: missing raw F0.
F0 (Hz). Vertical dotted bounds: selected evidence region; no octave correction.
Semitones: blue raw on retained median baseline; green production median-smoothed evidence.
Drawer Mine: purple DASHED = display geometry only (recentered). Orange = canonical reference ONLY.
Canonical reference uses arbitrary teaching amplitude; never fitted to audio. Mobile fits Mine horizontally to voiced span.
Energy envelope: 40-ms RMS (black); dashed red = existing energy gate; gray = diagnostic active threshold.
Praat selected-candidate autocorrelation strength (NOT calibrated voice probability or a creak measure).
